description: Write one Aircheck manifest for a post you just queued, or an ad creative you just rendered, into <queue>/<YYYY-MM-DD>/<id>.json. The day comes from `at` in the configured timezone (today when absent). Pass `ad` to make it an ad creative: same manifest, reviewed in Ads instead of Social. Pass `email` to make it an email: reviewed in Email, with its rendered message drawn as the reader sees it. Validates first and returns the problems rather than writing a bad file. Call this when the post or creative is BUILT, not when it is sent.

ad.description: Present only for an ad creative. Its presence is what makes the manifest a creative. `lane` is then the ad platform or account.

approved.description: A person signed off. Repair will not replace an approved creative.

format.description: The placement it is cut for: carousel-feed, still-square, video-portrait-15s, search-text...

product.description: What the creative is about. Required.

recipe.description: The recipe or script that built it, so Repair can re-run it.

run.description: The production run it belongs to. Creatives are grouped by run.

at.description: When it sends, ISO 8601. Leave out for an unscheduled post.

day.description: Override the YYYY-MM-DD folder. Normally leave this to `at`.

email.description: Present only for an email (a newsletter, a product email, a sequence step). Its presence is what makes the manifest an email. `lane` is then the sender or list. `at` is when it sends.

html.description: The rendered HTML message: an absolute path on this machine (served by the bridge, so it must sit in a mediaRoot) or a URL. Write the file first.

preheader.description: The preview line an inbox shows after the subject.

to.description: Recipient addresses, or the name of the list it goes to.

id.description: The manifest filename. Generated from the lane and the time when absent.

kind.description: text, image, carousel, video, thread or article. Inferred from media when absent.

lane.description: Which account/lane this goes out on. Must match the lane id configured in Aircheck.

media.description: Ordered media sources. A string is a relative path (against the manifest folder), an absolute path, or an https URL. An object is { path | url, alt }.

meta.description: Anything producer-specific worth keeping with the post.

status.description: A post: queued, sent, held or failed (default queued). An ad creative: draft, review, approved, live or archived (default draft). A word from the other ladder is refused.

text.description: The copy, exactly as it will post. Not a summary.

url.description: The link the post points at.

name: queue_post
